```{r config}
################################################################################
# ---- Configuration ----

pick_pipeline <- "my_local"  # "my_local" or "github"

# ---- my paths (inputs + outputs) ----

# ---- Pipeline switch ----
if (pick_pipeline == "my_local") {

  # ---- my paths (inputs+outputs) ----
  # Inputs from my local folder
  data_dir <- file_path
  out_dir  <- file.path(file_path, "output")
  save_outputs <- TRUE

} else if (pick_pipeline == "github") {

  # ---- GitHub repo paths ----
  # By opening `thyroid_hormone_ciona.Rproj` in RStudio, `here()` finds the project root
  repo_dir <- here::here()

  # Fallback: if you downloaded the repo as a zip and unzipped it
  if (!dir.exists(file.path(repo_dir, "data"))) {
    repo_dir_try <- normalizePath(path.expand("~/Downloads/thyroid_hormone_ciona-main"), mustWork = FALSE)
    if (dir.exists(file.path(repo_dir_try, "data"))) {
      repo_dir <- repo_dir_try
    } else {
      stop("Cannot find repo 'data/' folder.\n",
           "  → Open the .Rproj file in RStudio, OR\n",
           "  → Set working directory to repo root with setwd(), OR\n",
           "  → Unzip thyroid_hormone_ciona-main.zip and update the path above.")
    }
  }

  data_dir <- file.path(repo_dir, "data")
  out_dir  <- file.path(repo_dir, "output_rerun")
  save_outputs <- TRUE

  # Uncomment line below to NOT save outputs when running from GitHub:
  # save_outputs <- FALSE

} else {
  stop("pick_pipeline must be either 'my_local' or 'github'")
}

# ---- Path functions ----
dpath <- function(...) file.path(data_dir, ...)
opath <- function(...) file.path(out_dir, ...)

# Back-compat with older scripts

# Only create output dir when actually saving
if (save_outputs) dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---- Configuration summary ----
message("─────────────────────────────────────────")
message("Pipeline: ", pick_pipeline)
message("Data dir (inputs): ", data_dir)
if (exists("repo_dir")) message("Repo dir: ", repo_dir)
message("Save outputs: ", save_outputs)
if (save_outputs) message("Output dir: ", out_dir)
message("─────────────────────────────────────────")
```

```{r theme}
################################################################################
# ---- Theme & Style ----
################################################################################

custom_theme <- function() {
  theme(
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.09, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(20, "pt"),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    legend.box.background = element_blank(),
    legend.key = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )
}

################################################################################
# ---- Functions ----

# ---- pretty p-values for kable ----
format_pvalues <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(across(any_of(c("p.value", "p.value.x", "p.value.y", "adj.p.value")), 
                  ~ case_when(
                    . < 0.001 ~ format(., scientific = TRUE, digits = 2),
                    TRUE ~ as.character(round(., 4))
                  )))
}

# ---- load helper ----
assert_file_exists <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop("Input file not found:\n  ", path,
         "\n\nCheck `file_path` / `data_dir`, or whether the file is inside a subfolder.")
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}
```

## Fig S6 — Nkx2.1 reporter

```{r load_data}
################################################################################
# ---- Load & Process Data ----
################################################################################

# ---- Nkx2.1 reporter dataset ----
input_file <- dpath("4_endodermal_strand_migration.xlsx")
assert_file_exists(input_file)

endo_strand <- read_excel(input_file)

# ---- data wrangling ----
process_panel_data <- function(data, panel_name) {
  # First filter and select
  result <- data |> 
    filter(panel == panel_name) |> 
    dplyr::select(-panel)

  # Conditionally remove first row for panel_b
  if (panel_name == "panel_b") {
    result <- result |> slice(-1)
  }

  # Continue with the rest of the processing
  result |> 
    pivot_longer(-c(1, 2), names_to = "counts", values_to = "n") |> 
    mutate(n = as.numeric(n)) |>
    separate(counts, into = c("counts", "timepoint"), sep = "_") |> 
    pivot_wider(names_from = counts, values_from = n) |> 
    mutate(percentage = nCount / total) |>  
    Rmisc::summarySE(measurevar = "percentage", 
                     groupvars = c("timepoint", "Group")) |> 
    mutate(timepoint_num = as.numeric(str_remove(timepoint, "hpf")))
}

panel_a_b_data <- process_panel_data(endo_strand, "panel_a")
panel_c_data   <- process_panel_data(endo_strand, "panel_b")

# quick check
panel_a_b_data |> head() |> kable()
panel_c_data |> head() |> kable()
```

```{r embryo_numbers}
#| warning: false

################################################################################
# ---- Embryo numbers ----
################################################################################

# ---- embryo counts one line per panel x timepoint ----
get_embryo_summary_with_panel <- function(data, panel_filter) {
  df_panel <- data |>
    dplyr::filter(panel == panel_filter) |>
    dplyr::select(-panel) |> 
    dplyr::select(Group, starts_with("total_")) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with("total_"),
      names_to = "col",
      values_to = "total"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      total = as.numeric(total),
      timepoint = stringr::str_remove(col, "^total_"),
      timepoint_num = as.numeric(stringr::str_remove(timepoint, "hpf"))
    ) |>
    dplyr::group_by(Group, timepoint, timepoint_num) |>
    dplyr::summarise(total = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::mutate(label = paste0("n=", total)) |>
    dplyr::arrange(timepoint_num, Group)

  # lines like: "Panel A - 17.5hpf: control n=..., Thr n=..., Thr_WRPW n=..."
  embryo_lines <- df_panel |>
    dplyr::group_by(timepoint, timepoint_num) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      line = paste0(panel_filter, " - ", timepoint, ": ", paste0(Group, " ", label, collapse = ", ")),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(timepoint_num) |>
    dplyr::distinct(timepoint, timepoint_num, line)

  return(embryo_lines)
}

# Get all summaries
all_summaries <- purrr::map_df(
  c("panel_a", "panel_b", "panel_c"),
  ~ get_embryo_summary_with_panel(endo_strand, .x)
)

cat(paste0(all_summaries$line, "\n"))
```

### Figure S6 - plot

```{r fig_s6}
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-width: 18
#| 
################################################################################
# ---- Fig S6: endodermal-strand-migration (Nkx2.1 reporter) ----
################################################################################


# ---- plotting function ----
plot_percentage_data <- function(data, colors, x_var, group_breaks = NULL, group_labels = NULL,legend_position = NULL) {

  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = {{ x_var }}, y = percentage,color = Group, group = Group)) +
    geom_line(size = 1.5) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = percentage - se,
                    ymax = percentage + se,
                    fill = Group),
                linetype = 0,alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    custom_theme() +
    labs(y = "% of tail regression progress") +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors,breaks = group_breaks,labels = group_labels) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors,breaks = group_breaks,labels = group_labels) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format())

  if (!is.null(legend_position)) {
    p <- p + theme(legend.position = legend_position)
  }

  p
}


# Panel A plots
panel_a_breaks <- c("control", "TR", "TR_WRPW")
panel_a_labels <- c("Control", "TR", "TR::WRPW")

plot_tr <- plot_percentage_data(
  panel_a_b_data |> filter(str_detect(Group, "control|TR")),
  panel_a_colors,
  x_var = timepoint_num,
  group_breaks  = panel_a_breaks,
  group_labels  = panel_a_labels,
  legend_position = c(0.2, 0.9)
) + labs(x = "Hours post fertilization")

  # scale_x_continuous(
  #   breaks = unique(panel_a_data$timepoint_num),
  #   labels = unique(panel_a_data$timepoint)
  # )


# Panel B plots
panel_b_breaks <- c("control", "hox10", "hox10_WRPW")
panel_b_labels <- c("Control", "Hox10", "Hox10::WRPW")

plot_hox10 <- plot_percentage_data(
  panel_a_b_data |> filter(str_detect(Group, "control|hox10")),
  panel_b_colors,
  x_var = timepoint_num,
  group_breaks  = panel_b_breaks,
  group_labels  = panel_b_labels,
  legend_position = c(0.2, 0.9)
) + labs(x = "Hours post fertilization")

  # scale_x_continuous(
  #   breaks = unique(panel_a_data$timepoint_num),
  #   labels = unique(panel_a_data$timepoint)
  # )

# Panel C plots
panel_c_breaks <- c("control", "hox10_WRPW_TR", "TR_WRPW_hox10")
panel_c_labels <- c("Control", "Hox10::WRPW & TR", "TR::WRPW & Hox10")

plot_panel_c <- plot_percentage_data(
  panel_c_data,
  panel_c_colors,
  x_var = timepoint_num,
  group_breaks = panel_c_breaks,
  group_labels = panel_c_labels,
  legend_position = c(0.2, 0.9)
) + labs(x = "Hours post fertilization")

# Combine with equal sizing
final_plot <- plot_tr + plot_hox10 + plot_panel_c +
  plot_layout(nrow = 1, widths = c(1, 1, 1)) &
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A') &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold"))

final_plot
```

## Fig S7 — Zip2 reporter

```{r load_data_zip2}
#| warning: false

################################################################################
# ---- Fig S7: endodermal-strand-migration (Zip2 reporter) ----
################################################################################

input_file_s5 <- dpath("5_endodermal_strand_migration-zip2.xlsx")
assert_file_exists(input_file_s5)

endo_strand_zip <- read_excel(input_file_s5)

# =========================
# Tidy + summarize (mean + se by Group x timepoint)
# =========================
endo_summary_zip <- endo_strand_zip |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Group, Replicate),
    names_to = "metric_time",
    values_to = "n"
  ) |>
  mutate(n = as.numeric(n)) |>
  separate(metric_time, into = c("metric", "timepoint"), sep = "_") |>
  mutate(timepoint_num = as.numeric(str_remove(timepoint, "hpf"))) |>
  group_by(Group, Replicate, timepoint, timepoint_num, metric) |>
  summarise(n = sum(n, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = n) |>
  mutate(percentage = nCount / total) |>
  Rmisc::summarySE(measurevar = "percentage", groupvars = c("timepoint", "Group")) |>
  mutate(timepoint_num = as.numeric(str_remove(timepoint, "hpf"))) |>
  arrange(timepoint_num, Group)

endo_summary_zip |> kable()

# =========================
# Embryo numbers per timepoint 
# =========================

# Embryo line labels for plotting
embryo_n <- endo_strand_zip |>
  select(Group, starts_with("total_")) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("total_"),
    names_to = "col",
    values_to = "total"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    total = as.numeric(total),
    timepoint = str_remove(col, "^total_"),
    timepoint_num = as.numeric(str_remove(timepoint, "hpf"))
  ) |>
  # sum embryos per Group x timepoint
  group_by(Group, timepoint, timepoint_num) |>
  summarise(total = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(label = paste0("n=", total)) |>
  arrange(timepoint_num, Group)

# lines like: "17.5hpf: control n=..., TR n=..., TR_WRPW n=..."
embryo_lines_zip <- embryo_n |>
  group_by(timepoint, timepoint_num) |>
  reframe(
    line = paste0(timepoint, ": ", paste0(Group, " ", label, collapse = ", ")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(timepoint_num) |>
  distinct(timepoint, timepoint_num, line)

cat(paste0(embryo_lines_zip$line, "\n"))
```

### Figure S7 - plot

```{r fig_s7}
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-width: 8

################################################################################
# ---- Plot: Zip2 reporter ----
################################################################################

# one-row-per-timepoint for bottom text
embryo_lines_plot <- embryo_lines_zip |>
  distinct(timepoint, timepoint_num, line) |>
  mutate(
    line = stringr::str_remove(line, "^.*?:\\s*"), #remove the "17.5hpf: " prefix
    line = stringr::str_replace_all(line, ",\\s*", "\n") # put each group on its own line
  ) |>
  arrange(timepoint_num)

zip_plot <- ggplot(endo_summary_zip, aes(x = timepoint_num, y = percentage, color = Group, group = Group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = percentage - se, ymax = percentage + se, fill = Group),
    alpha = 0.4, colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  # add the lines at the bottom (one per timepoint)
  geom_text(
    data = embryo_lines_plot,
    aes(x = timepoint_num, y = -0.04, label = line),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3,
    lineheight = 0.95
  ) +
  custom_theme() +
  labs(
    x = "Hours post fertilization",
    y = "% of tail regression progress"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  scale_color_manual(values = panel_a_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = panel_a_colors) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.10, 1), clip = "off") +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.2, 0.9),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 30, 5.5)  # extra bottom space for text
  )
zip_plot
```

```{r save_plots}

################################################################################
# ---- Save outputs ----
################################################################################

if (save_outputs) {

  # =========================
  # Fig S6 (Nkx2.1 reporter)
  # =========================
  ggsave(opath("figS6_endodermal strand_00.pdf"), final_plot,
         width = 15, height = 5, dpi = 300)

  width_in <- 40
  aspect_ratio <- 3 / 4
  height_in <- width_in * aspect_ratio

  width_mm <- 4 * width_in / 25.4
  height_mm <- 4 * height_in / 25.4

  save_plot(
    plot = final_plot,
    base_height = height_in,
    base_asp = width_in / height_in,
    file = opath("figS6_endodermal strand_01.pdf")
  )

  cowplot::save_plot(
    plot = final_plot,
    base_height = 0.9 * 3.71,
    base_asp = 0.9 * 1.618,
    file = opath("figS6_endodermal strand_02.pdf")
  )

  cowplot::save_plot(
    plot = final_plot,
    base_height = 1.9 * 3.71,
    base_asp = 1.9 * 1.618,
    file = opath("figS6_endodermal strand_03.pdf")
  )

  # =========================
  # Fig S7 (Zip2 reporter)
  # =========================
  ggsave(opath("figS7_endodermal strand_zip_00.pdf"), zip_plot,
         width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)

  CairoPDF(opath("figS7_endodermal strand_zip_01.pdf"),
           width = width_mm, height = height_mm)
  print(zip_plot)
  dev.off()

  cowplot::save_plot(
    plot = zip_plot,
    base_height = 0.9 * 3.71,
    base_asp = 0.9 * 1.618,
    file = opath("figS7_endodermal strand_zip_02.pdf")
  )

  cowplot::save_plot(
    plot = zip_plot,
    base_height = 1.9 * 3.71,
    base_asp = 1.9 * 1.618,
    file = opath("figS7_endodermal strand_zip_03.pdf")
  )
}
```
